name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Kody (Codes) tab
description:
## Why?

The Codes tab injects partner HTML/JS/CSS into the storefront. It is gated on `enableHtmlInclude` and is only shown to services allowed to inject code, so it needs its visibility rule ported as carefully as its fields.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/HtmlIncludes.tpl` to React, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partial.

Fields: `addonRepositoryUrl` (text), three code editors `codes[header]`, `codes[footer]`, `codes[orderFinale]`, and the checkboxes `blankModeJs` and `blankModeCss`. The tab renders only when `enableHtmlInclude` is set on the service; the blank-mode checkboxes additionally depend on `blankModeAllowed`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Tab renders only when `enableHtmlInclude` is set; hidden otherwise on both create and edit
- All three code editors render with the legacy editor mode and syntax highlighting, and round-trip content unchanged
- `blankModeJs` and `blankModeCss` respect `blankModeAllowed`
- `addonRepositoryUrl` saves and validates as before
- Field names in the POST body unchanged
- Every `data-testid` from `HtmlIncludes.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `HtmlIncludes.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/HtmlIncludes.tpl:18,31,40,49,61,67`
- `cms/packages/Frontend/Helper/HtmlInclude.php`, `cms/packages/Frontend/HtmlInclude/Model/Addon.php`
- Data: `st_api.service` (`enableHtmlInclude`, `blankModeCss`, `blankModeJs`, `blankModeAllowed`), `st_api.addon_html_include`
